# ankra_cluster_variables (Data Source)

Lists a cluster's variables. The counterpart of `ankra cluster variables list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cluster_variables" "production" {
  cluster_id = ankra_cluster.production.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `cluster_id`.
- `variables` (Attributes List) Variables on the cluster, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables))

<a id="nestedatt--variables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the variable.
- `name` (String) Variable name.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value.
